observation_alphabet.P: parent unchanged: current repository value is expected parent_blob p

minimal_transition_relation.U_on_P: Stay U (unresolved/prepared). ADVANCE is forbidden. The only admissible replay is the same certificate CAS p→c with the same (p,slice_id).
minimal_transition_relation.U_on_S: Transition U→C (certificate committed). ADVANCE may be attempted only as CAS c→a, where a is a deterministic ADVANCE descendant bound to (p,slice_id,c).
minimal_transition_relation.U_or_C_on_D: Do not infer success from D alone. Validate descendant identity. If D equals the exact expected ADVANCE descendant a, transition to A (advanced, replay-stable); otherwise transition to F (fenced/conflict unresolved). In both A and F, further ADVANCE from (p,slice_id) is forbidden.
minimal_transition_relation.C_on_S: Stay C. A lost/ambiguous ADVANCE acknowledgement may replay only the same CAS c→a; no second logical ADVANCE identity is allowed.
minimal_transition_relation.A_on_expected_D: Stay A; duplicate ADVANCE is suppressed.
minimal_transition_relation.F_on_any: Stay F for this parent_blob+slice_id; no reclassification to PASS/ADVANCE without a new validated parent identity.

bounded_leaf_result.monotonicity_order: U < C < A and U < F; C < A and C < F. There is no transition from A or F back to U/C for the same (parent_blob,slice_id). Repository CAS consumes the exact predecessor value, so once c is replaced by any descendant, a second c→ADVANCE CAS cannot succeed.
bounded_leaf_result.safety_argument: After an accept-no-ack ADVANCE, a later read cannot safely cause a duplicate logical ADVANCE if every retry reuses the same expected predecessor c and same deterministic descendant a. If a was accepted, c is no longer current, so any second CAS c→a fails. If D is observed, the relation forbids another ADVANCE; exact-a means already advanced, any other descendant means fenced conflict.
bounded_leaf_result.liveness_argument: After an accept-no-ack certificate write p→c, eventual exact read of c yields S and recovers C, enabling the single deterministic c→a step. After an accept-no-ack c→a, eventual exact read of a yields D with exact expected descendant identity and recovers A. Thus replay from the same (p,slice_id) is preserved without relying on acknowledgement delivery.
bounded_leaf_result.identity_lower_bound: The raw three-symbol alphabet {P,S,D} is insufficient by itself to satisfy both safety and replay liveness because D conflates 'our accepted ADVANCE descendant' with 'a conflicting descendant'. A deterministic decoder that maps all D to A can falsely accept conflicts; one that maps all D to F cannot recognize an accepted no-ack ADVANCE. The minimal additional information is not a new mutable coordinator but exact descendant identity: D must be checked against deterministic a=(transition=ADVANCE,parent_certificate_blob=c,parent_blob=p,slice_id=s).

crash_window_cases.certificate_ack_ambiguous_then_P: No commit evidence; stay U and allow same p→c replay only.
crash_window_cases.certificate_ack_ambiguous_then_S: Certificate accepted; enter C and permit only c→a.
crash_window_cases.certificate_ack_ambiguous_then_D: Fence unless D is independently proven to be the exact expected descendant under the same lineage; never infer certificate success from unrelated D.
crash_window_cases.advance_ack_ambiguous_then_S: No descendant observed; stay C and allow same c→a replay only.
crash_window_cases.advance_ack_ambiguous_then_exact_a: Recover A; do not ADVANCE again.
crash_window_cases.advance_ack_ambiguous_then_other_D: Enter F; do not ADVANCE again.
